PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme for Advanced Pregnant Lifter"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Upper Body & Mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
